source_notes: All port actions require explicit invoking local owner, active generation and normal runtime admission. Do not trust caller-supplied source/origin text.

DTMF status replies go to the exact local RF or peer connection source; CLI/REST responses stay on request interface. Recheck source/grant/generation across async work. Source loss retires stale work.
All remote state-changing commands are administrative(); radio Status/GetSetting/Memory/Catalog/ScanStatus/CurrentStatus remain public even when DTMF mutations disabled.

remote_dtmf_access Open allows mutation without code; Locked requires the exact source's live grant; Disabled denies mutation. The physical provider still validates capabilities, RF limits and safety, regardless of source authorization.

Administrative DTMF grants require both salted unlock/lock hashes and expire under configured timeout; only successful administrative completion renews. Credential strings are not authored macro actions.
Link targets use inbound/outbound allow/deny and topology admission. Permanent connection does not implicitly wait until remote transport establishes. Outage retry belongs to existing LinkManager.
DTMF Command has select-vs-forward overload and collector-local # exit; those are separate source-session concerns, not a single persistent destination configuration.

Existing baseline DTMF macros forbid credential-bearing operations, PadTest, nested named macros and unverified cross-host targets; future call_macro is an explicit extension. Bare AdminLock prefix is allowed to revoke the source grant.

DTMF prefix length <=63, collector complete payload length <=127, allowed prefix characters0-9A-D. Actual human input permits16DTMFsymbols. Node-destination args1..63decimaldigits; configured message/site selectors canonical positive decimal up to127digits.
Default DTMF keys named disconnect_all/reconnect_all mean permanent-only operations; typed actions with the same all-link spellings retain true all-link semantics.

SiteController executes actions in list order; per-action faults become SiteEffect::Fault and later site actions still run. Preserve this domain-specific behavior; new command macros instead stop remaining actions on failure.

Alarm trip/clear/repeat message is a named local-only telemetry notification. Equipment effects run once independent of notification queue space; notifications coalesce by (local,name) and retry admission without rerunning equipment actions.

EEPROM validity input flags are ignored by the native tuning adapter and become result-only metadata.
Asterisk batch DTMF historically appends #; the new user contract instead requires an actual configured termination event and forbids implicit terminator injection.
Tuner active selection/follow are client presentation; flash/calibration are compositions of existing primitives. Host callbacks and provider handles are not serializable operator arguments.
Exact matching permanent intent is idempotent in the new connect_permanent adapter; the current raw handler still reports Loop for an already unpaused duplicate.
